question: Коя категория строителство показва най-висок ръст в броя на разрешенията от 2012 до 2022 г.?
question_english: Which construction category shows the highest growth in number of permits from 2012 to 2022?
model_answer: Based on the graph, the "Административни" (Administrative) category shows the highest growth in building permits from 2012 to 2022. It increased significantly from 4,238 to 8,169, surpassing the growth of the "Други" (Other) category.
